title: Everyday Phrases — Graduation Day
scene_zh: 畢業典禮 · 情境對話
title_quote: Hi, I came for my graduation gown.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🎓 實用畢業典禮必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Graduation Day
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用畢業典禮情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Graduation Day phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I came for my graduation gown.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ, aɪ keɪm fər maɪ ˌɡrædʒuˈeɪʃən ɡaʊn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome! Did you book a time?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, I booked the ten o'clock slot.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, aɪ bʊkt ði tɛn əˈklɑk slɑt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, your name is listed here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I find the right size?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ faɪnd ðə raɪt saɪz?/
dialogue.zh: 我該怎麼找到合適的尺寸？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell me your height first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am about five foot ten.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then try this medium robe.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sleeves look a bit long.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Roll them once at the cuff.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better! Does it need a tie?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, just zip the front.
dialogue.zh: 不用，拉上前面的拉鏈就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the matching cap?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Up there, on the second shelf.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This square hat feels funny.
dialogue.zh: 這頂方帽子感覺好有趣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone says that on day one.
dialogue.zh: 每個人第一天都這麼說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which way should the tassel face?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it on the right today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And it moves after I graduate?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, move it to the left.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need the hood too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only masters wear hoods here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, I am just a bachelor.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A bachelor with a great smile.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get my name sticker?
dialogue.zh: 可以領我的名牌貼紙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write it on these little tags.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I keep the paper slip?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that slip gets the robe back.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðæt slɪp ɡɛts ðə roʊb bæk./
dialogue.zh: 要的，憑這張單子歸還學士袍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When do I bring it back?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By Monday at the same desk.
dialogue.zh: 週一之前，同樣這個櫃台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My parents arrive at noon today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is so exciting for them!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can their car park?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lot C is closest to the hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɑt si ɪz ˈkloʊsɪst tə ðə hɔl./
dialogue.zh: C 停車場離禮堂最近。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the parking free for guests?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring this pass to show them.
dialogue.zh: 拿這張通行證給管理員看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they need to buy tickets?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, each family gets four seats.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four seats feels a little tight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Isn't your grandma coming too?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Grandma makes five in all.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask the office about extra chairs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rehearsal starts in one hour.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did you get your row number?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am in row twelve, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ɪn roʊ twɛlv, aɪ θɪŋk./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Row twelve, seat two for me.
dialogue.zh: 我也是十二排，坐第二號位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stand on the taped mark, see?
dialogue.zh: 站在膠帶記號上，看到沒？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This X is my spot today.
dialogue.zh: 這個 X 就是我今天的位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Walk slowly on the stage.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like a happy penguin?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly like a happy penguin.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will practice my slow walk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The mic will say your name.
dialogue.zh: 麥克風會念出你的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I check my pronunciation?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Practice saying it very clearly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My name trips up every new person.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ neɪm trɪps ʌp ˈɛvri nu ˈpɜrsən./
dialogue.zh: 我的名字總讓新同學卡關。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smile when you shake hands.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With the dean? I am nervous.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One small shake, then walk on.
dialogue.zh: 輕輕握一下，繼續往前走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And do not stop to talk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clapping starts at the very end.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So I just walk and smile?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is all you must do.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, that sounds doable.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do we meet after practice?
dialogue.zh: 彩排之後我們在哪裡集合？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By the big library steps.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will hold our two spots.
dialogue.zh: 我會幫我們先佔好位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring water, the hall is hot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good call, I have a spare bottle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd kɔl, aɪ hæv ə spɛr ˈbɑtəl./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You think of everything today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my cap too crooked?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tilt it flat, like this.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The mirror says I look sharp.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You look like a real graduate.
dialogue.zh: 你看起來真像個畢業生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Real graduates still feel scared.
dialogue.zh: 真正的畢業生也會害怕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Scared and happy at once.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is exactly how I feel.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me too, since early this morning.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，從一大早就這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you iron your white shirt?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I ironed it last night.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine still has one small wrinkle.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Steam from the shower fixes it.
dialogue.zh: 洗澡的蒸氣會把它弄平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shoes matter more than the gown.
dialogue.zh: 鞋子其實比學士袍重要。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wear your comfiest black pair.
dialogue.zh: 穿你最舒服的那雙黑鞋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My new shoes already pinch.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put tape on your little toe.
dialogue.zh: 在小腳趾上貼一道膠帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You always solve every problem.
dialogue.zh: 你總是有辦法解決問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Someone must keep us calm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The weather looks kind today.
dialogue.zh: 今天的天氣看起來很溫柔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sunny with just a soft breeze.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect for a long ceremony.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hope the band plays well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They open with the school song.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We sang it at orientation once.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it feels like our anthem.
dialogue.zh: 現在聽起來像我們的戰歌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four years change everything, right?
dialogue.zh: 四年真的改變一切，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It changed me for sure.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soon you start something new.
dialogue.zh: 很快你就要開始新生活。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am ready for what comes next.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈrɛdi fər wɑt kʌmz nɛkst./
dialogue.zh: 我準備好迎接下一階段。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We both are. Deep breath.
dialogue.zh: 我們都準備好了。深呼吸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The doors are opening now!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us go in with the crowd.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs ɡoʊ ɪn wɪð ðə kraʊd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This hall is so much bigger inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs hɔl ɪz soʊ mʌtʃ ˈbɪɡər ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 禮堂裡面比外面大得多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the seats are so soft.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I spy our row back there.
dialogue.zh: 我看到我們那排在後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Number twelve, right by the aisle.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Row twelve, seats one and two.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both empty seats wait for us.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, my family waved at me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your mom looks so proud today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My grandma brought her old camera.
dialogue.zh: 奶奶帶上了她的舊相機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grandmas always save the best shots.
dialogue.zh: 奶奶總能拍到最好的畫面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The graduates are lining up now.
dialogue.zh: 畢業生們正在排隊進場。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By college, science first, right?
dialogue.zh: 按學院排，理學院先對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our group walks in third.
dialogue.zh: 我們那一組第三個進場。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Heads up, music is starting.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That trumpet sound gives me chills.
dialogue.zh: 那聲小號讓我渾身起雞皮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Chills in a good way?
dialogue.zh: 是好的那種起雞皮疙瘩？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The best kind of chills.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, follow the tall banner.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here comes the president on stage.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He will keep it short, I hope.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi wɪl kip ɪt ʃɔrt, aɪ hoʊp./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He thanks every teacher in the room.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi θæŋks ˈɛvri ˈtitʃər ɪn ðə rum./
dialogue.zh: 他感謝在場的每一位老師。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My chemistry teacher is waving.
dialogue.zh: 我的化學老師正在揮手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He told the campus squirrel story.
dialogue.zh: 他講了校園松鼠那個笑話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The whole hall laughed out loud.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now he wishes us good luck.
dialogue.zh: 現在他祝我們一路好運。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That part felt surprisingly moving.
dialogue.zh: 那一段意外地讓人動容。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My eyes got a little wet.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same. Tissues are in my bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You carry tissues everywhere?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A graduate must stay ready.
dialogue.zh: 畢業生必須隨時準備好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They are reading names now.
dialogue.zh: 現在開始一一唸名字了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which letter are they at?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still on the letter B, sadly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your D will take a while.
dialogue.zh: 你的 D 還得再等一會兒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will practice my wave.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small wave, big smile, remember?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Listen, that sounded like my name!
dialogue.zh: 聽，剛好像是在叫我的名字！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, that was a different D.
dialogue.zh: 不，那個 D 不是你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My heart is racing right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breathe slow, count to four.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There! He said my name!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand tall and go get it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slow steps, penguin style.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect! Nobody rushed you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I shook the president's warm hand.
dialogue.zh: 我握到了校長溫暖的手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And you did not freeze there.
dialogue.zh: 而且你當場一點也沒僵住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The diploma case felt so heavy.
dialogue.zh: 證書夾拿在手裡好厚重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Heavy with four hard years.
dialogue.zh: 沉甸甸的是那四年辛苦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They clapped for every single name.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Including one very long foreign name.
dialogue.zh: 還有一個很長的外國名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hers took a full minute!
dialogue.zh: 她的名字整整唸了一分鐘！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The applause never stopped for her.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our song played during the walk.
dialogue.zh: 上台時播放了我們的歌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hummed along the whole time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it over already?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, just the blessing left.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everyone bowed their heads.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even the noisy kids were quiet.
dialogue.zh: 連吵鬧的孩子都安靜了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the tassel moves left!
dialogue.zh: 現在流蘇要撥到左邊了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did you remember to move it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I flipped it right on cue.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Official graduate, at last.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The crowd cheered like a stadium.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I screamed until my voice left.
dialogue.zh: 我喊到喉嚨都沒了聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we free to stand up?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait for the ushers to nod.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They wave their arms like birds.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Polite birds with very bright vests.
dialogue.zh: 是有禮貌、穿亮背心的小鳥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our dean wore a purple stole.
dialogue.zh: 我們院長披了紫色綾帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Purple means wisdom, they say.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wisdom says take a good photo.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: After this hall empties out.
dialogue.zh: 等這禮堂的人散開之後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I still cannot believe we did it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ stɪl ˈkænɑt bɪˈliv wi dɪd ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我仍不敢相信我們做到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We did it, every single one.
dialogue.zh: 我們都做到了，一個人也不少。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you see the twins graduate?
dialogue.zh: 你看到那對雙胞胎畢業了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They waved at each other twice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone dropped his shiny cap.
dialogue.zh: 有人掉了他那頂亮亮的帽子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A guy caught it in the air.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ɡaɪ kɔt ɪt ɪn ði ɛr./
dialogue.zh: 有個同學在半空接住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is our movie moment.
dialogue.zh: 那就是我們的電影鏡頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow motion and all.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The orchestra played us out.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One last walk together.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Family hugs wait outside the doors.
dialogue.zh: 家人的擁抱在門外等著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flowers everywhere, I can smell them.
dialogue.zh: 到處是花，我都聞到香了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we run or walk out?
dialogue.zh: 我們該跑出去還是慢慢走？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Walk, then hug like bears.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢走，然後像熊一樣抱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My dad cried. Is that okay?
dialogue.zh: 我爸哭了。這樣沒關係吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dads cry in the best movies.
dialogue.zh: 爸爸們在最棒的電影裡也會哭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your family is waving over here.
dialogue.zh: 你家人在這邊朝你揮手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My little sister made a banner.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A banner made by hand, how cute.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈbænər meɪd baɪ hænd, haʊ kjut./
dialogue.zh: 手工做的布條，真是太可愛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She glued stars all over it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Photos first, food can wait.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The photographer wears our school colors.
dialogue.zh: 攝影師穿著我們校的顏色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we pose by the fountain?
dialogue.zh: 我們要對著噴泉擺姿勢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is our favorite meeting spot.
dialogue.zh: 那是我們最愛的聚會老地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All those years led to this hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl ðoʊz jɪrz lɛd tə ðɪs ˈaʊər./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And we made it shine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chin down, cap straight, smile.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That camera loves me already.
dialogue.zh: 那台相機好像已經喜歡我了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blink once and ruin the shot.
dialogue.zh: 眨一下眼就毀了這張照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One more take, please?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The photographer says you are done.
dialogue.zh: 攝影師說你這一輪拍完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now it is my turn, hurry.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now a photo with your parents.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand between them, chin up.
dialogue.zh: 站在他們中間，抬起下巴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Group shot with all my cousins.
dialogue.zh: 和所有表親拍一張合照。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine people, one big bench.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who sits in the tiny chairs?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The little kids, always them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My cousin said cheese so loudly.
dialogue.zh: 我表弟喊茄子喊得超大聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now the picture has two blinks.
dialogue.zh: 現在照片裡有兩個人在眨眼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep it, it is perfect chaos.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Chaos prints nicer than poses.
dialogue.zh: 自然的比擺拍的更好看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you bring the yearbook?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, plus three colorful markers.
dialogue.zh: 帶來了，還有三枝彩色筆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write something nice on my page.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What should I even say?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say we met on day one.
dialogue.zh: 就寫我們第一天就認識。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lost cafeteria story?
dialogue.zh: 寫迷路餐廳那個故事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That story lives there forever.
dialogue.zh: 那個故事要永遠留在那一頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will add a tiny drawing.
dialogue.zh: 我再補一個小小的插畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A drawing of me, I hope.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A very tall version of you.
dialogue.zh: 畫一個把你拉很高的版本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You remember my terrible first speech?
dialogue.zh: 還記得我糟糕透頂的首演嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your hands shook the whole time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write that down, be honest.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Honesty plus kindness, deal.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sign here for good luck wishes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With your name and this year?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Class of this year, of course.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will keep this book safe.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we thank Mr. Chen now?
dialogue.zh: 我們現在去感謝陳老師好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He waits by the history door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He stayed late every Friday.
dialogue.zh: 他每個星期五都留到很晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: To help slow learners like us.
dialogue.zh: 就為了幫我們這樣慢一點的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I brought him a small thank you card.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ brɔt hɪm ə smɔl θæŋk ju kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 我帶了一張小卡片給他。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He will keep it on his desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi wɪl kip ɪt ɑn hɪz dɛsk./
dialogue.zh: 他會把它擺在辦公桌上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His eyes went soft and wet.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Teachers never say goodbye well.
dialogue.zh: 老師們從不擅長說再見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He called us his brave group.
dialogue.zh: 他說我們是他勇敢的一屆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am keeping that sentence forever.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is your favorite teacher now?
dialogue.zh: 你最喜歡的老師現在在哪？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Music room, she never left school.
dialogue.zh: 音樂教室，她從沒離開過學校。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cap toss at five o'clock sharp!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My hat flew far at rehearsal.
dialogue.zh: 彩排時我的帽子就飛好遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Throw it up with one hand.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And do not drop it on heads.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd du nɑt drɑp ɪt ɑn hɛdz./
dialogue.zh: 千萬別掉在別人的頭上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everyone shouts three, then toss!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three, two, one, up they go!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A whole sky full of black hats.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə hoʊl skaɪ fʊl əv blæk hæts./
dialogue.zh: 整片天空都是黑色的帽子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like a flock of happy birds.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My cap landed in a bush.
dialogue.zh: 我的帽子栽進了灌木叢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even the bushes graduate today.
dialogue.zh: 連灌木叢今天都畢業了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Photos, hugs, and one more toss?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if you hold my flowers.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your bouquet smells like spring.
dialogue.zh: 你的花束聞起來有春天味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My aunt sent it this morning.
dialogue.zh: 是我阿姨今天早上送來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Careful, the roses have tiny thorns.
dialogue.zh: 小心，玫瑰上有小小的刺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ouch, see what you did?
dialogue.zh: 哎喲，看到了吧，都怪你提醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put them down, I will take them.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ðɛm daʊn, aɪ wɪl teɪk ðɛm./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That was very gentlemanly of you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anybody seen my water bottle?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the bench by the stage.
dialogue.zh: 去看看舞台旁邊那張長椅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gone! My phone is missing too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lost and found is in the gym.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɔst ənd faʊnd ɪz ɪn ðə dʒɪm./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which side of the gym?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Left of the trophy glass case.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The table is full of umbrellas.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And at least forty black caps.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Caps everywhere, this is funny.
dialogue.zh: 到處都是帽子，太好笑了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nobody claims their own cap.
dialogue.zh: 沒人來認領自己的帽子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A volunteer found them both!
dialogue.zh: 有位志工把兩樣都找到了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She checked every lost item bag.
dialogue.zh: 她把每個遺失袋都翻過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I owe her a big coffee.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two coffees, she earned it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My sister lost her earring.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look under the folding chairs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it stuck to the tape.
dialogue.zh: 找到了，黏在地板膠帶上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Earrings love the rehearsal floor.
dialogue.zh: 耳環最愛黏在彩排的地板。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did anyone take my jacket?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It hangs by the door, relax.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh good, nothing else is lost.
dialogue.zh: 還好，沒有再丟別的東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? Nothing important went missing.
dialogue.zh: 你看吧，重要的一樣沒少。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can everyone squeeze into one van?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four in front, five in back.
dialogue.zh: 前面坐四個，後面坐五個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, my uncle can drive it.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，舅舅可以開那輛車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us two walk over.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will text the group chat.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell them the snacks are gone.
dialogue.zh: 順便說點心都被吃光了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which tent is serving food?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Outside, behind the red tent.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The line must be a mile!
dialogue.zh: 這隊伍大概有一英里長吧！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Long lines make good parties.
dialogue.zh: 排長龍代表派對夠熱鬧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now we dance, sleep later.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep is a very distant friend.
dialogue.zh: 睡覺是很遙遠的朋友嘍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last group photo, all of us.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn læst ɡrup ˈfoʊtoʊ, ɔl əv ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 來一張最後的全體合照。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say flowers, not cheese this time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, dinner with my whole family!
dialogue.zh: 現在，和我全家人一起吃晚餐！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You had me at the word dinner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju hæd mi æt ðə wɜrd ˈdɪnər./
dialogue.zh: 聽到吃飯兩個字我就來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The restaurant is across the square.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our old Friday noodle place?
dialogue.zh: 是我們以前星期五吃麵的那家嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! The corner with red signs.
dialogue.zh: 對！街角掛紅招牌的那家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The waiters there know us well.
dialogue.zh: 那兒的服務生都認得我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Grandma insists on sitting next to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡrændmɑ ɪnˈsɪsts ɑn ˈsɪtɪŋ nɛkst tə mi./
dialogue.zh: 奶奶堅持要坐在我旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grandmas claim the best chairs always.
dialogue.zh: 奶奶們永遠鎖定最好的座位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The menu looks bigger than before.
dialogue.zh: 菜單看起來比以前更厚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Order your favorite hot soup.
dialogue.zh: 點一碗你最愛的熱湯吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two large bowls of beef noodle.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Extra greens, that is the way.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dad ordered the fish for everyone.
dialogue.zh: 爸爸幫大家點了一尾魚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He shares like a generous king.
dialogue.zh: 他分菜像一位慷慨的國王。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pass the chili, just a little.
dialogue.zh: 把辣醬遞給我，加一點點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful, that jar bites back hard.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This table feels like a warm hug.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈteɪbəl filz laɪk ə wɔrm hʌɡ./
dialogue.zh: 這張桌子像一個溫暖的擁抱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Full bellies make the best hugs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Uncle raises his glass for a toast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌŋkəl ˈreɪsəz hɪz ɡlæs fər ə toʊst./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: To our graduate, loud and clear!
dialogue.zh: 敬我們的畢業生，大聲又清楚！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everyone clinked at the same time.
dialogue.zh: 大家的杯子同時噹一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Juice for the kids, wine for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒus fər ðə kɪdz, waɪn fər ʌs./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Grandma handed me a small box.
dialogue.zh: 奶奶遞給我一個小盒子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Her handwriting on top says luck.
dialogue.zh: 盒蓋上她親筆寫著好運。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Inside: her old silver pen.
dialogue.zh: 盒子裡是她那支舊銀筆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That pen signed fifty report cards.
dialogue.zh: 那支筆簽過五十張成績單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will write my first paycheck with it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl raɪt maɪ fɜrst ˈpeɪtʃɛk wɪð ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 到時要用它簽領第一份薪水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One step at a time, dear.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My parents gave me a new watch.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈpɛrənts ɡeɪv mi ə nu wɑtʃ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right on time for new adventures.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your gift card made me laugh.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bookstore money is never wasted money.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My sister drew me a rainbow card.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈsɪstər dru mi ə ˈreɪnˌboʊ kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 我妹妹畫了一張彩虹卡給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hand drawn beats store bought, always.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What are your plans for summer?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two weeks rest, then my internship.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How did you get that offer?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The campus fair, last spring.
dialogue.zh: 去年春天的校園博覽會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I remember you asking so politely.
dialogue.zh: 記得你當時問得特別有禮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That politeness opened the whole door.
dialogue.zh: 那份禮貌替我打開了門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When does the office want you?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First Monday of next month.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is soon. Are you scared?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Excited first, scared right after.
dialogue.zh: 先興奮，然後才輪到害怕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I finally got the cafe job.
dialogue.zh: 我終於拿到咖啡店的工讀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free coffee forever, nice work!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My shifts start late, sleep till noon.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ʃɪfts stɑrt leɪt, slip tɪl nun./
dialogue.zh: 我的班表晚開始，能睡到中午。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The dream schedule of every student.
dialogue.zh: 這是每個學生的夢幻排班。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the company email you back?
dialogue.zh: 那家公司回信給你了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they want me in August!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, two offers, you are busy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I choose the one with kind people.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ tʃuz ðə wʌn wɪð kaɪnd ˈpipəl./
dialogue.zh: 我選同事善良的那一家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smart. Kind bosses change everything.
dialogue.zh: 聰明。好主管會改變一切。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You learned that from our deans.
dialogue.zh: 這道理是院長們教我們的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dessert came, and I am full.
dialogue.zh: 甜點上桌，可我已經好飽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save room, mango cake is next.
dialogue.zh: 留點肚，再來是芒果蛋糕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One slice, and share the tea.
dialogue.zh: 一人一塊茶點，一起喝杯茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two cups, same pot, old style.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bill was paid before we asked.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɪl wʌz peɪd bɪˈfɔr wi æskt./
dialogue.zh: 結帳的事在我們開口前就辦好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grandma snuck off to pay it.
dialogue.zh: 是奶奶偷偷溜去買單了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We should thank her properly, right?
dialogue.zh: 我們該好好謝謝她，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will walk her home slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I already miss our old campus walls.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɔlˈrɛdi mɪs ˈaʊər oʊld ˈkæmpəs wɔlz./
dialogue.zh: 我已經開始想念校園的牆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The walls heard every one of our stories.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wɔlz hɜrd ˈɛvri wʌn əv ˈaʊər ˈstɔriz./
dialogue.zh: 那些牆聽過我們每個故事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We should walk through the gates soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ʃʊd wɔk θru ðə ɡeɪts sun./
dialogue.zh: 我們很快要再走過校門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our reunion is the perfect excuse.
dialogue.zh: 同學會就是最完美的藉口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next June, same campus, same gates.
dialogue.zh: 明年六月，同樣校園同樣門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same bench, same funny poses?
dialogue.zh: 同一張長椅，同樣搞笑的姿勢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bring the yearbook, signed pages and all.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ðə ˈjɪrˌbʊk, saɪnd ˈpeɪdʒəz ənd ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 記得帶紀念冊，還有簽名頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the caps, for old times.
dialogue.zh: 再帶上畢業帽，重溫舊時光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The group chat is blowing up already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡrup tʃæt ɪz ˈbloʊɪŋ ʌp ɔlˈrɛdi./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sixteen replies before dessert ended.
dialogue.zh: 甜點還沒吃完就十六則回覆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Home at last, what a day.
dialogue.zh: 終於到家了，真是充實的一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My feet forgot they had shoes.
dialogue.zh: 我的腳都忘了自己還穿著鞋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hang the gown up carefully.
dialogue.zh: 把學士袍小心地掛起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Zip it, smooth it, give it air.
dialogue.phonetic: /zɪp ɪt, smuð ɪt, ɡɪv ɪt ɛr./
dialogue.zh: 拉好拉鏈，捋平，讓它透透氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I place the cap with care.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our best clothes need real respect.
dialogue.zh: 最好的衣服值得好好對待。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put the photos somewhere safe.
dialogue.zh: 把照片收到安全的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I taped mine above my desk.
dialogue.zh: 我的已經貼在書桌上方了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The yearbook goes under my pillow.
dialogue.zh: 紀念冊要放在我的枕頭下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sweet dreams live in its pages.
dialogue.zh: 甜甜的美夢住在它的頁裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow the summer truly starts.
dialogue.zh: 明天起，暑假才真正開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New roads, same old friends.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am tired and so happy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The best kind of tired, truly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn down the lamp, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One soft click, the room is calm.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn sɔft klɪk, ðə rum ɪz kɑm./
dialogue.zh: 輕輕一按，房間就安靜了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Today played back like a soft movie.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈdeɪ pleɪd bæk laɪk ə sɔft ˈmuvi./
dialogue.zh: 今天回想起來像一部溫柔電影。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A happy ending with applause.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good night, brave graduate friend.
dialogue.zh: 晚安，我勇敢的畢業生朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good night, the future is yours.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Close your eyes, breathe out slow.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In for four, out for six.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am all set for tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 我已經為明天準備妥當。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep now, I will call at nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip naʊ, aɪ wɪl kɔl æt naɪn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See you soon inside my dreams.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dream big tonight, graduate.
dialogue.zh: 今晚做個大大的夢，畢業生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good night, sweet commencement day.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good night, sleepy superstar.
